node.statement: By the exact contract of lem-hcb1-column-action, instantiated at the compatible amplified corner pair (P,R), the element V=Z dot W in M_n tensor S_{P,R}, and X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{R,Q}, one has q_P(T_1)<=C_act*e*||Z dot W||*q_R(X). This step uses no product-norm estimate.
